title: ListNodeRangesResponse
description: Range information for a specific node with pagination metadata.

ranges.description: Array of range information objects for the node.

next.description: Offset for retrieving the next page of results.

RangeDescriptor.description: Describes a range's identity, key bounds, and replica set.

start_key.description: Base64-encoded start key of the range.

end_key.description: Base64-encoded end key of the range.

internal_replicas.description: List of replicas for this range.

store_id.description: Store on the node hosting this replica.

replica_id.description: Unique identifier of this replica within the range.

RangeInfo.description: Information about a single range, including span, replica placement, lease holder, and per-replica statistics.

span.description: Key span covered by this range.

source_node_id.description: Node ID that provided this range information.

source_store_id.description: Store ID on the source node that holds this range.

error_message.description: Error message if range information could not be retrieved.

lease_holder.description: Store ID of the current leaseholder replica.

raft_state.description: Raft consensus state of this range (e.g. Leader, Follower).

stats.description: Aggregate statistics for the range including key/value counts.
